13s CT - 2000% Light DMG (MAG). For 8s, increase own Arts by 4/s. Additionally, increase own Arts by 20 if own Skill hits the Boss (1 HIT).
Note: This unit's Arts Gen is Type EX1 and will stack with all other Arts Gen effects apart from the same unit.
skillset.arts: 25000% Light DMG (MAG). Each time own Arts is used, permanently increase Light allies' DMG by 50% (MAX: 200%).
skillset.truearts: 70000% Light DMG (MAG). Increase own DMG against non-Boss enemies by 200% for the duration of own True Arts. For 40s, increase allies' ATK by 130%.
skillset.superarts: 190000% Light DMG (MAG). For 25s, reduce enemies' MAG RES by 150% and Break RES by 50%.

passive.ability1: At the start of Battle (Wave), increase Light allies' Arts by 25 and Human allies' Arts by an additional 25. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
passive.ability2: Increase own DMG by [2 x own ATK/100]%.
passive.ability4: Unit EXP UP 20% UP. (When Nonon's SP. Art is owned)
passive.ability5: At the Start of Quest, increase own Arts gauge by 10. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name. (When Nonon's SP. Art is owned)

trueweapon.skill: 60s CT - 8000% Light DMG (MAG). For 10s, reduce enemies' DMG RES by 20%. If user is Light, reduce enemies' DMG RES by an additional 10%. If user is Human, reduce enemies' DMG RES by an additional 10%.
